name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 4 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 23 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 29 hours starting 2025-04-29, at wavelengths from 1.64 to 4.89 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
